name: The Summoning
objectiveText: Bring the Whirlwind Heart to Bath'rah Windwatcher. Whirlwind Heart  ( 1 )

comments.body: Also be aware that Cyclonian is a Level 40 Elite Elemental. You'll need a friend to assist you in killing him in order to obtain the Whirlwind Heart.

[b]Pre Level 40 (heroic strike):[/b]

Get the SWORD. You'll be mostly using Heroic Strike which adds it's damage to the next available swing. Faster weapon, more swings, more damage.

[b]Post Level 40 (mortal strike):[/b]

Get the AXE if you're an ARMS/Mortal Strike build. MS is an instant attack and you want the highest possible top end damage available.

Instant attack formula: https://www.wowhead.com/forever/search?q=Normalized

The MACE is a waste of time.

Warrior rule.
Tankerbelle

Was able to solo this as a level 38 arms human in quest greens and still using Archeus (~24 dps). Pop a nature protection potion as you accept the quest and wait until there's about 30 seconds left on cooldown before you pull. I also used a stamina food buff, an agility elixir, a strength elixir, and a regeneration potion.

Keep up demoralizing shout and backpedal while stacking Sunder Armor. You want to be using as many instant attacks as possible to help fish for overpower procs. He has 2 different skills that you can easily outrange just by backpedalling and he will randomly do a big knockback that won't do much damage. Pop your second nature protection potion when the first expires and if the fight drags on long enough you can use a third. Try to sneak in a bandage when he's using a skill and you're out of range of the skill. Note that he is immune to hamstring and retaliation so don't bother.

I beat him at about 50% remaining life and 2 nature pots used up. Maybe only 2-3 overpower procs. There's going to be some big RNG in your nature protection rolls (1350-2250) so it might take a few tries!

All the necessary things are already said in the discussions above. All I can say is Nature Protection Potion is a must have if you want to beat the Cyclonian (Level 40 Elite). He deals nature damage and the potion absorbs it. Keep more than one flask of potion with you since during the fight you end up drinking more potions.

Watch out for his whirlwind/knockback. The potion will absorb the damage but you will get knocked back a great distance. By the time you reach the Cyclonian, he will have healed - not fully but enough to make you irritated.

The reward is the [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=1792/whirlwind-weapon]Whirlwind Weapon[/url]. I got the sword. Ok first of all, all of the weapons are good in there own way. If you acutually look at the dps and damage the warhammer has the highest dps by a little bit then the sword then the axe. Overall, the axe has the most damage, then the warhammer, then the sword. The fastest of them all is the sword. The coolest looking in order is the axe, the sword, then the hammer. Once i beat this quest i ended up with the hammer since it has the best dps by about .1 and the damage of it is only about 10 or less below the axe. Ive seen all of these before and i must say that most people get the axe. But there is a reason why 2 handed swords are lower in damage of course. If you read online guides, two handed swords always have lower damage compared to axes and maces if you just look at the damage, but if u actually use them, the sword hits the most and is the fastest which explains the low damage. In the game ive been the only person so far that ive seen take the mace. Which is kinda cool in  a sense. it has no glowy blue light like the sword or no cool swirvy shape like the axe. it is basically a black chipped rock on a black stick with a spike on the top and on the bottom which is all black. So also consider if your class has a certain +5 specialty with weapons. Such as if you are a human warrior, get the sword or the mace (both great in my opinion). and if you are a horde definitly get the axe. (looks great on them plus good dmg)

If you get killed by the Cyclonian, the NPC  Bath-Rah won't talk to you again until you abandon the quest.  When you abandon the quest, the NPC gets the yellow ? back over his head, and starts you off again.  Taking some friends to help you is a good idea.  (But if you are a helper, and use Taunt in Def Stance, you may find it'll just get you bounced back a way).

Then I looked at the combat log, and a lot of his damage is nature damage, so just drank a nature protection potion which he ended up slapping out of me, but 1350 to 2250 health to my favor (I didn't notice how much protection I actually got). But he was only 25-50% health by the time I actually took any significant damage, and it was no contest...you can probably get away with being a few levels lower than 41. Good luck!

Cyclonian

What a bloody hard wind thing to beat. At level 41, I found it hard to beat this guy.

(Died 3 times)

But I found a tricks which will help

Right got to AH and buy
•	Magic Resistance Potions (Must have)
•	Super Healing Potions (You will need)

Both you will need, extras
•	Elixir of Strength 
•	Elixir of Agility
•	Elixir of Giant Growth
•	Elixir of Stamina

Or any other buffs you can find.

When fighting him, his physical attacks won’t do much damage – you are a warrior so take it! 

it’s the blasted Nature damage that is the killer. So watch your health. Also, if you see him casting, stop it, Shield bash (if you can switch quickly) or Pummel to stop it, if he hits you with one of them, expect to die soon.

If he knocks you back, charge back in with Inception ASAP, as he tends to heal himself if he is losing.

A final note, don’t be a coward and use a shield and main hand, either dual-wield or big 2-hand, as I said its not the physical attacks you should be worried about!

A small trick is to run in to the water, he can not get you. Heal, buff and try again.

Also, most of your special moves don’t work, either Immune or Resisted, so just go all out with rage, and shouts! And hope for those crit-hits
